title: AUDITING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: A THREE-LAYERED APPROACH
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper proposes a general auditing framework and does not conduct any specific benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research. It provides a blueprint for auditing LLMs on three levels: governance, model, and application, but does not apply this framework to religious contexts.
